cases.mechanism_detail: An ~3-kb antisense SVA_F1 inserted at c.1972 in MSH2 exon 12; tumours show loss of MSH2/MSH6. RT-PCR found an aberrant transcript ~300 bp longer than wild type, which the authors propose results from a splice donor inside the SVA, incorporating SVA sequence into the mRNA.
cases.quote: RT-PCR analysis indicated an aberrant MSH2 transcript with ~300 bp longer than the wild type transcript in one of the family members (Figure S1a).
